profile_improvement_tips: Learn and build a project in Python or JavaScript to match the JD's core language requirements; this is critical for a Google Cloud role.
Study distributed systems and large-scale system design concepts; implement a project demonstrating horizontal scaling, load balancing, or eventual consistency.
Gain hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, or Cloud Functions; migrate one of your existing projects to GCP.
Contribute to open-source projects or peer code reviews in a team setting to build and demonstrate code review and collaborative design skills.
Explore natural language processing (NLP) libraries (e.g., spaCy, NLTK, or Hugging Face) in a small project to broaden your AI/ML exposure.
final_resume.growth_note: You are a strong fresher with solid full-stack fundamentals in Java and React, but the JD explicitly requires 1+ year of professional software development experience and proficiency in Python, C, C++, or JavaScript. Your current profile lacks professional experience, multi-language exposure, and GCP/distributed systems depth. Focus on gaining 1 year of professional experience and learning Python or JavaScript to become a competitive candidate.
